scenario_description:
Objective: Use a same-day Foundation microgrant window to turn an optional written-test practice receipt into a possible small education reimbursement.
Emerging Need: A practice block, verified grants contact, available funds, and a completed portal receipt accumulate before an official queue notice makes any claim usable.
Decision Context: Stored microgrant rules and the active prep record determine whether the receipt qualifies, what details may be shared, and why scores or endorsements are irrelevant.
Consequence: Timely consideration could offset part of self-study spending; after the queue export, ordinary preparation continues with no grade, syllabus, or certification effect.

parameter.title: FAA written-test portal practice block
parameter.description: Optional self-study practice exam block at the VFC testing-prep kiosk; not a proctored FAA knowledge test.

parameter.name: VFC Foundation Learning Grants
parameter.notes: Verified through the VFC directory on 2026-04-15; handles learner microgrant notices and receipt questions, not instruction approvals or endorsements.

parameter.description: Personal study-budget transfer for optional written-test preparation.
FAA written-test authorization practice exam at the VFC testing-prep kiosk.

parameter.subject: Same-day microgrant queue: written-test prep expenses
parameter.body: The optional learner microgrant queue is open until 18:20 today for April written-test prep expenses that satisfy the published Foundation rules. Use the verified Foundation Learning Grants contact; include receipt identifier, merchant, time, and amount only. Awards are discretionary and do not affect coursework, endorsements, or FAA testing status.

parameter.subject: Microgrant queue closed for April 15
parameter.body: The 18:20 queue export is complete; Learning Grants will not add more April 15 same-day written-test prep claims to this batch. Later messages can be answered for general information only.
